name.text: Place the estimated value of mode in stacked dotplot

questiontext.text:
The precipitation in {@ds1@} Eastern African cities in August was measured and the results were grouped in intervals of 6mm. The results are displayed in the graph below. Place the mode line in the modal value 'by eye;.

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ans1="sR1" input-ref-ans2="sR2"]] JXG.Options.text.useMathJax = true; // Create empty list of points var p = []; // Create board var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [{#xmin#}, {#ymax#}, {#xmax#}, {#ymin#}], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis:true, pan:{enabled:false} }); // Create points for the Data Set var lx1 = {#dorx1#}; var ly1 = {#dory#}; var i = 0; for (i = 0; i <= lx1.length - 1; i++) { p[i] = board.create('point', [lx1[i], ly1[i]], { face: 'x', name: '', size: 2, fixed:true }); } // Create hidden point for the mean var qm1 = board.create('point', [5,0], { name: "C", size: 2, visible: false }); // Line for the mean var qm11 = board.create('point', [5,5], { name: "C", size: 2, visible: false }); var m1 = board.create('line', [qm1, qm11], { straightFirst: true, straightLast: true, strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#21a34c' }); var lblm1 = board.create('text', [function() {return qm1.X()+1},{#ymax-1#},'mode'], { fontSize: 15, color: '#21a34c' }); /* Set answers from state of graph */ stack_jxg.bind_point(sR1,qm1); stack_jxg.bind_point(sR2,qm11); board.unsuspendUpdate(); [[/jsxgraph]]

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: Your answer for the mode is close enough. The actual value is {@m3@} mm.
Your answer for the mode is almost close enough. The actual value is {@m3@} mm, with practice you should be able to estimate the mode to within 10%.
If there is more than one modal value then you should take the mean of the modal values as the mode.

falsefeedback.text: You are a bit too far from the actual mode value of {@mr1@} mm. Your estimate of the mode is more than 20% away.
